messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["bear", "beetle"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A quadrupedal creature standing in profile with the furry brown head, small rounded ears, eyes, muzzle, and clawed paws of a bear, but the rest of its body is encased in a glossy dark brown-black segmented exoskeleton like a giant beetle or pillbug, with a large domed plate over the shoulders, overlapping segments along the arched back tapering to a point at the rear, segmented armor over the neck and all four legs, and a single long curved serrated black beetle horn rising from the top of its head and arching backward.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "brown furry bear head with brown eyes, tan muzzle and black nose", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the creature"}, {"looks_like": "long glossy black curved beetle horn with serrated inner edge", "part": "horn", "where": "on top of the head curving up and backward"}, {"looks_like": "small rounded brown furry bear ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of the head on either side of the horn base"}, {"looks_like": "thick short legs encased in glossy black segmented armor", "part": "legs", "where": "under the body, two in front and two in rear"}, {"looks_like": "brown furry bear paws with long claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the bottom of each of the four legs"}, {"looks_like": "glossy dark brown-black segmented beetle-like exoskeleton with oval side openings", "part": "shell", "where": "covering the back, sides, neck, shoulders, hips and upper legs"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 0, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
